div.div:
getVisibleFiles() = filterByType(sortByName(files, direction), filter)
the filter is applied on top of the sorted list, so the chosen order
survives switching the filter; both functions are unit-tested in @shelf/shared

div.div:
«boundary» (teal) — UI controls the user interacts with
«control» (amber) — orchestration and client state
«utility» (lavender) — FileListOperations: pure functions in @shelf/shared
«entity» (green) / «enumeration» (slate) — domain data (see the domain class diagram)
